Version 1.0.9 fixes duplicate cleanup freezes and improves recovery from damaged but readable Matroska sources.

- Excluding duplicate and probable-duplicate tracks no longer causes recursive UI updates or traceback spam.
- Bulk cleanup remains responsive on previews containing hundreds of tracks.
- Subtitle analysis continues when `mkvextract` resynchronizes a damaged source and produces every requested track.
- Real extraction failures still stop the operation instead of silently using incomplete output.
